The '''Dasoor Challenge''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course located on [[Dasoor/Legends|Dasoor]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], podracing legend [[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]] was scheduled to run a charity race in the Dasoor Challenge, to support Senator [[Jollin Resbin]]'s stand towards the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], to be voted that same day.
